purpose: Define time/revision-bounded evidence of compute, accelerator, memory, storage, network and platform capabilities used for placement/preflight decisions.

topics.name: Node Capability Snapshot
topics.purpose: Define time/revision-bounded evidence of compute, accelerator, memory, storage, network and platform capabilities used for placement/preflight decisions.

semantics.identity_rule: Each snapshot has explicit evidence identity.
semantics.software_rule: OS/runtime/driver/platform versions are explicit where material.
semantics.time_rule: Observation time is evidence and freshness is explicit.
semantics.placement_rule: Snapshot informs eligibility but does not authorize deployment.
semantics.stale_rule: Stale capability evidence may require refresh.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

references.purpose: Capabilities belong to exact compute node.

prose.summary: Define time/revision-bounded evidence of compute, accelerator, memory, storage, network and platform capabilities used for placement/preflight decisions.
